plainLanguage: Killeen switched to the 2024 national building codes on January 1, 2026, so new house plans must follow the 2024 Residential and Energy codes. Most new homes are in the R-1 district: plan on a 25-foot front yard, 5-foot side yards (15 feet next to a side street) and a 25-foot back yard. Houses can be up to 35 feet or two and a half stories tall. Killeen has design rules for every new house: the garage door can be no wider than half the front of the house, and the house needs at least five decorative features. There is no brick-percentage rule. Expect about $1,580 in water and sewer impact fees. The soil is clay that swells, so plan on an engineered foundation.
